title: In the Beginning — Christ the Firstborn
english: [[In the beginning God made heaven and earth >> Bible:Genesis 1:1]]. What is the beginning of all things if not our Lord and Savior of all, Jesus Christ, [[the firstborn of all creation >> Bible:Colossians 1:15]]? In this beginning, that is in his Word, God made heaven and earth, as the evangelist John says: [[In the beginning was the Word >> Bible:John 1:1]]. He does not mean some temporal beginning, but says that heaven and earth were made in the Beginning — that is, in the Savior. [[The earth was invisible and unordered, and darkness was over the abyss, and the Spirit of God was borne over the waters >> Bible:Genesis 1:2]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
After origen-song CLOSEOUT; Jeremiah–Samuel remainder closed.

title: Darkness over the abyss; Day One, not First
english: The earth was invisible and unordered before God said [[Let there be light >> Bible:Genesis 1:3]] and before he divided light from darkness. Darkness was over the abyss — that abyss in which the devil and his angels will be. So God dissolves the darkness: Let there be light, and light was made. He called the light Day and the darkness Night. [[There was evening and there was morning, day one >> Bible:Genesis 1:5]] — he did not say “first day,” because time was not yet before the world.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Firmament — spiritual heaven and bodily heaven
english: [[God said: Let there be a firmament in the midst of the water >> Bible:Genesis 1:6]]. Though God had already made heaven, he now makes the firmament — that is, the bodily heaven. For every body is firm and solid. The first heaven, spiritual substance, is our mind, the spiritual human who sees God. The firmament, the bodily heaven, is our outer human. If one can divide the upper waters from the lower, that one too will be called a heavenly human: [[Our citizenship is in heaven >> Bible:Philippians 3:20]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Divide the waters — living water vs the abyss
english: Let each of you strive to become a divider of the water above and the water beneath, so that, taking a share of spiritual water, you may bring [[rivers of living water from your belly >> Bible:John 7:38]], cut off from the water of the abyss where darkness and [[the prince of this world >> Bible:John 12:31]] dwell. By sharing that upper water the believer is made heavenly, thinking nothing of earth but all of the things above.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
After origen-song CLOSEOUT; Jeremiah–Samuel remainder closed.

title: Gather the waters; let dry land appear
english: [[God said: Let the water under heaven be gathered into one gathering, and let the dry land appear >> Bible:Genesis 1:9]]. Let us labor to gather the water under heaven and cast away our evil deeds, so that dry land may appear. If we do not separate those waters — the sins and vices of the body — our dry land cannot appear, nor have confidence to come to the light: [[Everyone who does evil hates the light >> Bible:John 3:20]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Dry land named Earth — fruit-bearing bodies
english: The water was gathered, and the dry land appeared. [[God called the dry land Earth >> Bible:Genesis 1:10]]. As dry land, once separated from water, is already named earth, so our bodies, if vices are separated, will no longer be called dry land but earth, able to bear for God. Whoever remains dry and brings forth thorns becomes food for fire; whoever shows himself fruitful earth may hope for [[a land flowing with milk and honey >> Bible:Exodus 3:8]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Let the earth put forth herb and fruit tree
english: [[God said: Let the earth put forth the herb of grass, seeding seed according to its kind, and the fruit tree making fruit whose seed is in itself >> Bible:Genesis 1:11]]. By the letter the fruits are plain. If we have already been made earth, not dry land, let us bring rich fruits to God, that we may be blessed: [[See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a full field >> Bible:Genesis 27:27]]. For earth that often drinks the rain and yields timely herb will receive blessing; that which brings forth thorns ends in burning.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Seeds of the virtues kept in the heart
english: He not only orders the earth to put forth grass, but also seed, so that it may always be able to bear fruit; not only a fruit tree, but one making fruit whose seed is in itself — that we keep the seeds of all the virtues in our heart, and from them carry out acts according to justice. Let this herb come to maturity with deeper roots in the heart, so that they bear fruit and hold seeds of what is to come.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Lights in the firmament of the heart
english: After this the firmament deserves to be adorned with lights. [[God said: Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven, to shine upon the earth and to divide day from night >> Bible:Genesis 1:14-15]]. Sun and moon and stars are set in the firmament — in the church and in the heavenly human — so that those still in the body may be ruled by the illumination of the Word and of the law and the prophets.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
After origen-song CLOSEOUT; Jeremiah–Samuel remainder closed.

title: For signs and seasons — first series closes
english: [[And let them be for signs and for seasons and for days and for years >> Bible:Genesis 1:14]]. The lights not only shine; they give signs: seasons of the virtues, days of knowledge, years of progress. Let us strive to have the Word’s lights in the firmament of our heart, that we may not walk in darkness but as [[children of light >> Bible:1 Thessalonians 5:5]]. This is Homily I’s first series, from the beginning of creation as far as the lights set for signs.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
After origen-song CLOSEOUT; Jeremiah–Samuel remainder closed.

title: Let the earth bring forth living soul — fleshly motions
english: [[God said: Let the earth bring forth the living soul according to its kind, four-footed creatures and creeping things and beasts of the earth according to their kind. And it was so >> Bible:Genesis 1:24-25]]. By the letter there is no puzzle. By spiritual understanding: what came from the waters are the mind’s motions and thoughts from the heart’s depth; what comes from the earth are the outer human’s — the fleshly and earthly — motions. Nothing winged is named here; only four-footed and creeping things and beasts. [[Put to death your members that are upon the earth >> Bible:Colossians 3:5]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
Homilia I §§11–17 CLOSEOUT.

title: Let us make humankind — dominion and God’s own making
english: [[God said: Let us make humankind in our image and likeness, and let them rule the fish of the sea and the birds of heaven and the beasts of the whole earth >> Bible:Genesis 1:26]]. God wants such a human to hold rule over those beasts already named. Let the waters — the mind — bring forth spiritual sense; let the earth — the flesh — put forth fleshly sense; and let the mind rule, not those over it. Mark the greatness: other things are made by command — [[Let there be a firmament >> Bible:Genesis 1:6]], [[Let the water be gathered >> Bible:Genesis 1:9]] — but of the human: Let us make. Only heaven and earth, the lights, and the human are ascribed as God’s own making.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
Homilia I §§11–17 CLOSEOUT.

title: Image of God is the interior human
english: More exalted still: [[God made humankind; in the image of God he made them >> Bible:Genesis 1:27]] — said neither of heaven nor of earth nor of the sun. We do not take this “in the image” as bodily. The body was [[molded from the mud of the earth >> Bible:Genesis 2:7]]; the one made in the image is our interior human — invisible, bodiless, incorrupt, immortal. To think the bodily is in the image is to invent a bodily God — impious. [[Heaven is my throne >> Bible:Isaiah 66:1]] does not mean stretched feet, but God’s rest in the citizenship of those whose [[commonwealth is in heaven >> Bible:Philippians 3:20]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).

title: Male and female; increase and multiply
english: [[Male and female he made them, and God blessed them, saying: Increase and multiply and fill the earth >> Bible:Genesis 1:27-28]]. The blessing of fruitfulness is given to those made in the image, so that God’s image may grow on the earth through generation and through the multiplying of the virtues in the soul.

title: Subdue the earth — the lesser world within
english: [[And subdue it and rule >> Bible:Genesis 1:28]]. They are ordered not only to fill the earth but to subdue it — that is, to subject flesh and earthly affections to reason and to God’s Word, so that the human made in the image may truly rule in the lesser world of the self.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
Homilia I §§11–17 CLOSEOUT.

title: Rule fish, birds, and beasts — passions under mind
english: [[And rule the fish of the sea and the birds of heaven and the cattle and the whole earth >> Bible:Genesis 1:28]]. That dominion, spiritually: over thoughts from the deep (fish), over winged senses, over cattle and beasts of the passions. If the mind holds first place, God’s image reigns; if the flesh does, beasts rule in us.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 29 (1920).

title: Food given — Homilia I CLOSEOUT
english: [[God said: Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant that sows seed upon the whole earth, and every tree that has in itself the fruit of its own seed, to be food for you >> Bible:Genesis 1:29]]. Food for the body and food for the soul: God’s Word and the virtues. This is Homily I’s close — from the beginning as far as the creature’s food. Amen.
